tagline: Certex取景器相机，1963 年发布
description: Certex于1963年推出的取景器相机。配备Laotor 1:3.5/45mm。快门速度speeds 1/30, 1/60, 1/125 sec.。使用35mm。

specs.英文简介: The Werlisa Color is a 35mm film viewfinder camera made in Spain from 1963[http://lascamarasdefernando.blogspot.com/search/label/Werlisa%20color%201963 Werlisa Color 1963 page at Las Camaras de Fernando] by Certex.
